oracle: Exact kernel builds; staged probe produces expected G78 identity and renderD node; EGL reports hardware renderer; repeated frame rendering and user taps/scrolls remain responsive; recoverable stop/reboot without calibration changes.

user_journey.scenario: Boot native Omarchy, open Files and terminal, type with onscreen keyboard, scroll, idle and wake, reconnect USB after interruption; operator can recover using current tested B image.
user_journey.expected: No black/unresponsive desktop, no recurring recovery fallback once boot marker separately verified.
